sql: select series_ticker, count(distinct event_ticker) events, count(*) mkts, min(start_date)::date::text first_seen, max(start_date)::date::text last_seen from incentive_programs where incentive_type='liquidity' and series_ticker ilike '%MENTION%' and start_date > now() - interval '35 days' group by 1 order by 2 desc
